sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to AFC Bridgnorth on Saturday (KO 15:00) looking to extend their excellent form. Sandbach have won five of their last six league matches and sit top of the table with 31 points from 13 games, while hosts Bridgnorth occupy fifth place with 24 points and have been inconsistent lately with mixed recent results.
divisionWide: The title race remains competitive: second-placed Bilston Town (26 points) and third-placed Stafford Town (25 points) are both in strong positions heading into their respective fixtures. Stafford host struggling Shawbury United, who have lost four of their last six matches, while Bilston are not in action this week. Elsewhere, in-form Allscott Heath face a challenging trip to Foley Meir; Allscott have won their last five league matches but visit a Foley side desperate for consistency. The bottom-half clash between Brereton Social and Dawley Town sees two sides (13 and 15 points respectively) fighting for points, while mid-table Cheadle Heath Nomads welcome Market Drayton Town in another competitive lower-table encounter. Widnes Town, anchored at the foot of the table with just 6 points, travel to Foley Meir.
